context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 38 verified Smart Scheduling Widget feature. The widget displays 6 AI-powered insight cards on Dashboard: 1) Needs Optimization (score < 60%), 2) Ready to Publish (drafts >= 70% older than 7 days), 3) Social Promotion (published articles with high views), 4) Content Gaps (keywords without pillar pages), 5) AI Trending Topics (gemini-2.0-flash suggestions), 6) Best Publishing Day (defaults to Tuesday 9-11 for accounting niche). Cache is per-user for 6 hours in db.insights_cache. Refresh button triggers ?refresh=true to bypass cache. 'Użyj' button on trending topics navigates to /generator with topic and keyword prefilled via URL query params.

insights.needs_optimization: Articles with surfer_score.percentage < 60%, sorted by lowest score, limit 5
insights.ready_to_publish: Drafts with score >= 70%, created > 7 days ago, not published on WP, limit 5
insights.social_promotion: Published articles sorted by wp_views_7d desc, limit 3
insights.content_gaps: Keywords with article_count >= 2 and no pillar page (max target_length < 2500), limit 5
insights.trending_topics: AI-generated via gemini-2.0-flash based on user's recent 15 articles, returns 1-2 topics
insights.best_publishing_time: Analyzes wp_published_at + wp_views to find best weekday, defaults to Tuesday 9-11
